title: 1996 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final
text:
{{Use dmy dates|date=October 2021}} {{Use Hiberno-English|date=October 2021}} {{Infobox football match | title = 1996 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final replay | image = | event = [[1996 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|1996 Munster Senior Hurling Championship]] | team1 = {{GG|Limerick|hurling}} | team1association = [[File:Limerick colours.PNG|40px]] | team1score = 4-7 | team2 = {{GG|Tipperary|hurling}} | team2association = [[File:Portumna GAA colours.PNG|40px]] | team2score = 0-16 | details = | date = 14 July 1996 | stadium = [[Páirc Uí Chaoimh]] | city = [[Cork (city)|Cork]] | man_of_the_match1a = [[Ciarán Carey]] ([[Limerick GAA|Limerick]]) | referee = | attendance = 40,000 | weather = Sunny | previous = [[1995 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|1995]] | next = [[1997 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|1997]] }} The '''1996 Munster Senior Hurling Championship finals''' were two [[hurling]] matches played in July 1996. The first game was played at the [[Gaelic Grounds]] in Limerick and finished in a draw 0–19 to 1–16, after Tipperary at one stage had a ten-point lead. The replay was played a week later on 14 July at [[Páirc Uí Chaoimh]], [[Cork (city)|Cork]], [[County Cork]], and saw Limerick claim their second first Munster Championship of the decade, winning on a scoreline of 4–7 to 0–16. Overall, this was Limerick's eighteenth [[Munster Senior Hurling Championship]] title.{{cite web|url=http://munster.gaa.ie/history/sh_teams/|title=Munster Final Winning Teams|work=Munster.gaa.ie|accessdate=23 June 2011|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110721124423/http://munster.gaa.ie/history/sh_teams/|archivedate=21 July 2011|url-status=dead}} Tipperay had defeated [[Waterford county hurling team|Waterford]] in the quarter-final by 1–14 to 1-11 and [[Kerry county hurling team|Kerry]] in the semi-final by 4–19 to 2–11 to reach the final, while Limerick had defeated [[Cork county hurling team|Cork]] by 3–18 to 1–8 in the quarter-final and [[1995 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final|All-Ireland Champions]] [[Clare county hurling team|Clare]] by 1–13 to 0–15 in the semi-final to reach the final.{{cite web|url=http://www.gaainfo.com/comp.php?co=intercounty&year=1996&comp=mshc|title=1996 Munster Championship Results|work=gainful.com|accessdate=23 June 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120923234940/http://www.gaainfo.com/comp.php?co=intercounty&year=1996&comp=mshc|archive-date=2012-09-23|url-status=dead}} Both matches were screened live by [[RTÉ]] as part of ''[[The Sunday Game]]'' programme.{{citation needed|date=October 2021}} ==Match== ===Details=== {{footballbox |date = 7 July
